excerpt: Google announced Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking on September 15. It says the models can continue live spoken interaction while processing tasks; 3.8 Live is rolling out in Search Live and Extended Thinking in Gemini Live. The described Docs features require Google AI Pro or Ultra, while Gmail and Keep features require a Google AI subscription.
limitations: Provider announcement and availability claims. A rollout does not establish task accuracy, equal availability across accounts, or independent performance.
